thread_text:
mara (CS): Quick weekly health note for Novus — onboarding traffic spike + higher error surface. Summary: overall error rate 3.8% (was 1.1% last week), avg p95 latency 720ms (up from 340ms), spend trending +14% M/M. Top failures below; please scan and call out immediate mitigations.

josh (SRE): grabbing traces now. initial read: mix of 5xx model OOMs and client-side retry amplification causing rate-limit bursts.

mara (CS): breakdown by category (last 24h):
- 5xx: 58% of failures (~2.2% absolute) — majority on long-generation paths
- timeouts: 27% (~1.0%) — centered around streaming endpoints during peak bursts
- rate-limits (429): 15% (~0.6%) — concentrated on small-batch embedding loops

Top failing endpoints (by failures, last 24h):
1) POST /v1/generate — 1,240 failures (5xx 68%, timeouts 20%, 429 12%) — common when seq_len > 2k tokens and client max_retries=5
2) POST /v1/chat/stream — 410 failures (timeouts 55%, 5xx 30%, 429 15%) — most errors between 18:12–18:22 UTC (batcher backlog)
3) POST /v1/embeddings — 190 failures (429 45%, 5xx 30%, timeouts 25%) — small requests with tight concurrency from client integration
4) POST /v1/rerank — 80 failures (5xx 40%, timeouts 35%, 429 25%)

josh (SRE): a few datapoints from traces:
- /v1/generate 5xx often shows runtime OOM on model variant `redwood-xl-1.1-fp16` during token 1800+ sequences.
- chat/stream timeouts correlate with a sudden backlog in the continuous-batcher; KV cache misses spiked ~3x which amplified compute.
- embeddings 429s look client-driven (no uniform backoff), hitting per-customer concurrency cap.

rene (Ops): immediate actions I pushed:
- bumped per-customer concurrency cap for Novus from 24 -> 36 for the dedicated pool (temporary) — watching CPU/GPU load (actioned 18:35 UTC).
- adjusted batcher window to strict max_batch_size=32 for the chat route to reduce tail latency.

josh (SRE): next steps I'm taking:
- roll a pinned model variant to `redwood-xl-1.1-fp16-safe` (quantized with lower mem footprint) to reduce OOMs during long sequences. ETA 30m.
- add a short-circuit: if seq_len > 1500, reject with clear client error recommending chunking (to avoid silent failures).
- instrument per-route client-retry metric to detect retry storms earlier.

ara (Acct): Novus flagged this as blocking a small cohort of onboarding users — they mentioned potential churn if onboarding flows don't stabilize. Need ETA for rollback/fix so we can update their CS queue and renewal risk doc.

mara (CS): noted. renewal risk flagged as "watch" until next check-in; customer enablement call scheduled Fri 10:00 PT. Please confirm the pinned variant rollout and whether we can offer Novus a temporary higher throttle while we stabilize.

josh (SRE): pinned variant rolled at 19:02 UTC by deploy-bot. Early metrics: 5xx on /v1/generate down ~60% in first 20m. Still monitoring p95 latency.

deploy-bot: deploy 1801234599 by josh (SRE) — rolled `redwood-xl-1.1-fp16-safe` to novus-dedicated pool. no errors in canary.

rene (Ops): followups/requests:
- ops to confirm GPU memory headroom in 2h and confirm we can keep increased concurrency for 24h.
- can somebody add a short note to Novus's enablement playbook describing chunking guidance and SDK backoff best-practices? (mara?)

mara (CS): will add note and ping enablement. Assigning: josh -> monitor errors & implement short-circuit, rene -> confirm capacity and retention of concurrency bump, mara -> update playbook & customer comms.

ara (Acct): thanks all — I'll hold off on renewal outreach until we see stabilization tomorrow. Marking high priority for Friday call. :thumbsup:

josh (SRE): quick log snippet for ops:
```
2026-03-19T18:14:07Z ERROR runtime OOM model=redwood-xl-1.1-fp16 seq_len=2431 pid=3421
2026-03-19T18:14:08Z WARN batcher backlog=46 route=chat/stream latency=2.3s
```

mara (CS): closing note: initial mitigations show improvement; we'll reconvene in tomorrow's check. If anything regresses ping #incidents.
